name: Last Call Market
summary: Work the night shift at a dying supermarket with up to 4 friends. Every shift comes with a shopping list: find every item, load your cart and scan it all at the registers before the clock runs out, while a blind monster hunts you by sound. Footsteps, a rattling cart, a dropped jar or a shout over proximity voice chat can give you away; throw a can down the next aisle to buy a few seconds. Four Nights and ten shifts across a supermarket, a depot and a market of rooms, with a new store layout and shopping list every run, monsters that each follow one simple rule, and wages to spend on upgrades between shifts.
